examples.en: Police in London are lining up a huge police operation for the Notting Hill Carnival in the wake of the rioting and looting that hit the city earlier this month.
examples.zh: 本月早些时候，伦敦发生了骚乱和抢劫事件，目前伦敦警方正在为诺丁山狂欢节组织大规模警力。

examples.en: Revellers gather in London’s Notting Hill for Europe’s biggest street carnival.
examples.zh: 狂欢客聚集伦敦诺丁山庆欧洲最大街头狂欢节

examples.en: The song, included on the “Notting Hill” movie soundtrack, hit number one on the UK charts.
examples.zh: 这首歌收录在《诺丁山》电影原声大碟，曾荣登英国排行榜榜首。
